title: External citation links allow unsafe URL schemes
reasoning: CitationsList passes citation.url directly into an anchor href for external citations. Because citation data crosses the user/API trust boundary, a malicious or corrupted URL using a non-http scheme such as javascript: or data: can be rendered as a clickable link. The existing test verifies only a benign https URL and rel/target attributes; rel="noopener noreferrer" does not validate the URL scheme.
reproduction: Return an external citation with citation_type 2 and url set to a javascript: or data: URL, then render CitationsList and click Visit source.
recommendation: Validate citation.url before rendering the anchor. Only allow http: and https: URLs via the URL constructor, and omit or neutralize the link for invalid or disallowed schemes.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The citation link test only asserts that https://example.com is rendered with target and rel attributes. It does not include hostile or malformed schemes.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a CitationsList test that returns an external citation with url: 'javascript:alert(1)' and asserts no clickable Visit source link is rendered, plus a positive test for http/https URLs.
minimumFixScope: Update CitationsList link rendering to use a small URL-scheme guard and extend CitationsList tests.
